title: Repair SRD magic-item boundaries and embedded content
description:
Problem

Magic-item coverage improved substantially, but the latest audit found boundary and embedded-content failures.

Known high-confidence failures

- Figurine of Wondrous Power is present in the SRD but missing as magic-item:figurine-of-wondrous-power.
- magic-item:feather-token swallows the Figurine of Wondrous Power heading, rarity line, figurine variants, and Giant Fly stat block.
- Several magic-item tables are likely flattened into descriptions rather than emitted or structured.
- Magic items may contain embedded stat blocks, option tables, dice-result tables, command words, variants, and child entities that need explicit accounting.

Task

Repair magic-item boundary parsing and structured child content.

Implementation guidance

- Build on the bounded source span bead.
- Build on the document-wide table and stat-block inventory beads where available.
- Every magic item heading in the source should map to exactly one magic-item record unless intentionally ignored with reason.
- Magic-item descriptions should not swallow following magic-item headings.
- Embedded tables should be emitted as table records or structured child data.
- Embedded stat blocks should be linked to the stat-block representation chosen by the stat-block bead.
- Preserve source text and provenance for variants and subentries.

Regression cases

Add tests for:

- magic-item:feather-token does not include Figurine of Wondrous Power.
- magic-item:figurine-of-wondrous-power exists and has correct source span.
- Giant Fly is accounted for structurally.
- At least one magic-item option table is accounted for.
- At least one magic-item dice-result table is accounted for.
- Deck of Many Things accounts for Avatar of Death according to the stat-block modeling decision.

Acceptance criteria

- All source magic item headings are accounted for.
- Known boundary bleed is fixed.
- Magic-item tables and embedded stat blocks are not silently flattened without coverage mappings.
- Existing valid magic-item ids remain stable where possible.
notes: Implemented in worktree branch agent/eshyra-4a7.8-magic-item-boundaries. Added Figurine of Wondrous Power with 9 structured variants and Giant Fly link; bounded Feather Token; captured Avatar of Death traits/actions; emitted all 27 remaining Magic Items table structures with reviewed deterministic reconstruction. Source coverage known-gap eshyra-4a7.8: 27 -> 0. Generated semantic diff: 28 records added, 0 removed, only existing record changed is stat-block:avatar-of-death. Verification: npm run format/check/typecheck/test (1587 passed, 19 documented skips) and npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack pass.
close_reason: Magic-item boundaries, embedded stat blocks, variants, and all source table structures are now deterministically emitted and verified.
